audit_items.proof_trace: Unknown transaction types are correctly rejected. For type bytes 0x00-0x7F, GetDecoder throws RlpException("Unknown transaction type") when _decoders[type] is null (lines 86-89). For bytes 0x80-0xFF, they are treated as Legacy and rejected by RLP decoder as malformed. The implementation uses RlpException instead of spec terminology "TransactionTypeError", but this naming difference doesn't affect correctness.
